method: Each archive claim was read against candidate derivation nodes of dag/derivations_dag.json (nodes citing the same paper folder, plus the 25 nodes with the highest word overlap) and against a free search of the DAG. matched: a node states the same result under the same or weaker hypotheses. partial: a node covers part of the claim, or the same object under different hypotheses (relation supports, narrows or refutes). gap: no derivation node covers it; a proposed derivation is written to dag/derivations/.
